**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback cure proposed).**

- **Grant scope (§2(a), p0022):** licence runs only to "Client" = Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. (preamble p0003). No affiliate coverage, no notice path, no contractor coverage.
- **Term (§2(c), p0028):** licence runs until termination — not revocable at will, so no walk-away trigger, but not a paid-up perpetual/irrevocable grant either.
- **Transfer (§15, p0080):** consent required for any transfer of rights, with only a mutual "financially responsible affiliate" exception — no successor/M&A transfer right for the licence.

Both fallback elements fail, so this is a deviation rather than an acceptable fallback bargain. The cure is a single new §2(e) carrying only the two fallback elements: affiliates covered on written notice, plus a **Client-only** transfer to an M&A successor (drafted as a narrow carve-out from §15 so TrueLink's assignment position is not expanded).
